scheme_name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
ministry: Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Monthly financial grant of ₹1,000 paid directly into the bank account of girl students pursuing Undergraduate Degree, Diploma, or ITI courses until completion.
exclusions: Students who studied Class 6 to 12 in private unaided schools (unless under RTE quota)
Students pursuing distance or correspondence education
documents_required: Class 6 to 12 Government School Study Certificate / EMIS ID
application_steps: Apply online through the Pudhumai Penn portal (penkalvi.tn.gov.in) via your college nodal officer.
Enter your EMIS school number to auto-verify Class 6 to 12 government school education.
Complete college verification to receive ₹1,000 monthly via DBT.
